headline: Good breadth environment. Be selective but don't miss the leaders.
trading_action_detail: Good breadth environment. Be selective but don't miss the leaders. Qullamaggie: 'You want something predictable. Something that works over and over and over again.' Stick to your best setups. Don't overthink the market — it's giving you green lights.

coach_note:
Good conditions. Stay long, stay focused. Qullamaggie's advice: 'You can average 100, 200% per year just trading the long side... But what you have to do is to be patient, wait for your spots.'
Brad Gilbert's rule: Play the percentages. Take your best setups. Don't force trades that aren't there. The market is giving you green lights — walk through them, don't run.
Process over outcome. Take your setups. Let the market do the work.
mental_anchor: Process over outcome. Take your setups. Let the market do the work.
mental_reset:
Before you open your scanner, take 60 seconds.
Close your eyes. Breathe in slowly — count to 4. Hold for 2. Exhale for 6.
Let go of today's P&L. Let go of yesterday's loss.
The breadth is supportive. Your job is to find the best setups and execute.
Open your eyes. You are ready.
trend_stage_detail: NEUTRAL TREND — Mixed signals. Freshness at 0.15, euphoria at 0.19, acceleration at 1.30. The market has not committed to a direction. Monthly momentum at 1.7x — barely positive. Damage ratio at 0.67 — significant bifurcation under the surface. Only trade the very best setups. Reduce size.
scan_quality_detail: Monthly momentum at 1.7x — barely positive. Most stocks going nowhere or down. The scan will produce very few quality setups. If you scan, be extremely selective. Better use of time: build your watchlist for when conditions improve. Qullamaggie: 'Sitting on your hands IS a position. Protect your capital.'
